d: A little girl named Masha lives in the forest with her dog, goat and pig, often getting into funny situations. She befriends a paternal bear who tries to keep her away from disaster.
Astronauts Leah and Zac are on a quest to speak to an alien. Shimmer and Shine send an alien right into her garden so she can talk to one face to face.
Rusty Rivets uses engineering, imagination and resourcefulness to repurpose spare parts and other objects he finds to come up with wild and cool contraptions, and save the day.
